Interface AlgoRecommendationJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<AlgoRecommendation>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>
public interface AlgoRecommendationJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<AlgoRecommendation, Integer>
Access to the current live plans of the assigned monitoring hierarchy. The rows are written by the live evaluation and read by the periodic due check, the checkpoint shown in the rebalancing report, the mean reversion trading view and the monitoring card of the dashboard; there is no create or update endpoint, which is why nothing here is exposed over REST. A historical replay neither reads nor writes them.

  • Method Details

    • findByIdTenantAndIdAlgoTopOrderByLevelTypeAscIdNodeAsc

      @Query("SELECT r FROM AlgoRecommendation r WHERE r.idTenant = ?1 AND r.idAlgoTop = ?2 AND r.triggerKind <> grafioschtrader.types.AlgoRebalancingTrigger.MEAN_REVERSION ORDER BY r.levelType, r.idNode") List<AlgoRecommendation> findByIdTenantAndIdAlgoTopOrderByLevelTypeAscIdNodeAsc(Integer idTenant, Integer idAlgoTop)
      The current plan of one AlgoTop in the tenant it was calculated for, which the monitoring card of the dashboard summarizes. Ordered so that the top level line comes first, then the buckets, then the instruments.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - tenant whose positions the plan was calculated against
      idAlgoTop - the AlgoTop the plan belongs to
      Returns:
      the lines of the current plan, empty when the AlgoTop has never been evaluated

    • findLastRunDate

      @Query("SELECT MAX(r.runDate) FROM AlgoRecommendation r WHERE r.idTenant = ?1 AND r.idAlgoTop = ?2 AND r.triggerKind <> grafioschtrader.types.AlgoRebalancingTrigger.MEAN_REVERSION") Optional<LocalDate> findLastRunDate(Integer idTenant, Integer idAlgoTop)
      The day the current plan of one AlgoTop was calculated. This decides whether the daily evaluation still has work to do; it says nothing about the periodic interval, because the plan is replaced on every evaluation.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - tenant whose positions the plan was calculated against
      idAlgoTop - the AlgoTop the plan belongs to
      Returns:
      the run day of the stored plan, or empty when there is none

    • findLastCheckpointDate

      @Query("SELECT MAX(r.checkpointDate) FROM AlgoRecommendation r WHERE r.idTenant = ?1 AND r.idAlgoTop = ?2 AND r.triggerKind <> grafioschtrader.types.AlgoRebalancingTrigger.MEAN_REVERSION") Optional<LocalDate> findLastCheckpointDate(Integer idTenant, Integer idAlgoTop)
      The valuation day of the last periodic checkpoint of one AlgoTop. The interval to the next checkpoint counts from this day. Every plan carries it over from the plan it replaces, so it survives the daily replacement of the rows.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - tenant whose positions the plan was calculated against
      idAlgoTop - the AlgoTop the plan belongs to
      Returns:
      the last checkpoint day, or empty when no checkpoint has been recorded

    • deleteByIdTenantAndIdAlgoTop

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM AlgoRecommendation r WHERE r.idTenant = ?1 AND r.idAlgoTop = ?2 AND r.triggerKind <> grafioschtrader.types.AlgoRebalancingTrigger.MEAN_REVERSION") int deleteByIdTenantAndIdAlgoTop(Integer idTenant, Integer idAlgoTop)
      Removes the previous plan of one AlgoTop, so that the rows written afterwards are the whole current plan rather than a mixture of two evaluations. A node that disappeared from the hierarchy between two runs leaves no orphan line behind this way.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - tenant whose plan is replaced
      idAlgoTop - the AlgoTop whose plan is replaced
      Returns:
      number of removed lines

    • deleteAllKindsByIdTenantAndIdAlgoTop

      @Transactional @Modifying @Query("DELETE FROM AlgoRecommendation r WHERE r.idTenant = ?1 AND r.idAlgoTop = ?2") int deleteAllKindsByIdTenantAndIdAlgoTop(Integer idTenant, Integer idAlgoTop)
      Removes every stored line of one AlgoTop, rebalancing plan and mean reversion proposals alike. Used when the hierarchy stops being the assigned monitoring hierarchy, because only that one keeps a live plan.
      Parameters:
      idTenant - main tenant that owns the hierarchy
      idAlgoTop - the AlgoTop whose lines are removed
      Returns:
      number of removed lines
